tasks.label: Package .love
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && zip -9 -r build/journey-trough-jhell.love main.lua conf.lua src lib assets -x '*.DS_Store'

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Force -Path main.lua,conf.lua,src,lib,assets -DestinationPath build/journey-trough-jhell.zip; Move-Item -Force build/journey-trough-jhell.zip build/journey-trough-jhell.love"
